title: Dizzy and drained
every time it's hot out?
3 habits worth checking
eyebrow: Beat the heat, the right way

items.name: Why This Happens
body: If you feel dizzy or drained
it might not be just the heat -

items.name: Caffeine
body: A big iced coffee or energy drink
but large doses act as a diuretic

items.name: Caffeine: The Fix
body: make plain water your main drink

items.name: Alcohol
body: It also pulls more fluid out

items.name: Alcohol: The Fix
body: then enjoy it once you've cooled off

headline: Caffeine, alcohol, and water-only habits -
these three are worth a second look
If dizziness or confusion
shows up with the heat, get to a cool place fast
tip: Match your fluids to your sweat -
water for normal days, electrolytes for heavy ones
